name: entrypoint-node-builtin-import
reason: Choosing the runtime platform is the job of an entry point, so nodeBuiltinImport is excluded there.

name: entrypoint-strict-effect-provide
reason: strictEffectProvide flags every Effect.provide whose argument is a Layer without reading the file’s role or scope; an entry point — a test, an example, a composition package — provides a caller-supplied Layer by design, and upstream ships the rule at the default `off`.
